Alif-Laam-Meem .
yeh uss hikmat wali kitab ki aayaten hain ,
jo naik logon  kay liye hidayat aur rehmat ban ker aai hai ,
woh naik log jo namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur zakat ada-kertay hain , aur aakhirat ka poora yaqeen rakhtay hain .
wohi hain jo apney perwerdigar ki taraf say seedhay raastay per hain , aur wohi hain jo falah paaney walay hain .

aur kuch log woh hain jo Allah say ghafil kernay wali baaton kay khareedaar bantay hain ,   takay unn kay zariye logon  ko bey samjhay boojhay Allah kay raastay say bhatkayen , aur uss ka mazaq urayen . inn logon  ko woh azab hoga jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .

aur jab aesay shaks kay samney humari aayaten parh ker sunai jati hain to woh pooray takabbur kay sath mun morr leta hai , jaisay unhen suna hi nahi , goya uss kay dono kanon mein behra-pann hai . lehaza uss ko aik dukh denay walay azab ki khushkhabri suna do .
albatta jo log emaan ley aaye , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye unn kay liye naimaton kay baaghaat hain ,
jinn mein woh hamesha rahen gay . yeh Allah ka sacha wada hai , aur woh iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

uss ney aasmano ko aesay sutonon kay baghair peda kiya jo tumhen nazar aa-saken ,   aur zameen mein paharon kay langar daal diye hain , takay woh tumhen ley ker dagmagaye nahi ,   aur uss mein her qisam kay janwer phela diye hain . aur hum ney aasman say paani barsaya , phir uss ( zameen ) mein her qabil-e-qadar qisam ki nabataat ugayen .
yeh hai Allah ki takhleeq ! abb zara mujhay dikhao kay Allah kay siwa kissi ney kiya peda kiya-? baat darasal yeh hai kay yeh zalim log khuli gumrahi mein mubtala hain .

aur hum ney luqman ko danai ata ki thi ,   ( aur unn say kaha tha ) kay Allah ka shukar kertay raho .   aur jo koi Allah ka shukar ada-kerta hai , woh khud apney faeeday kay liye shukar kerta hai , aur agar koi nashukri keray to Allah bara bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef !
aur woh waqt yaad kero jab luqman ney apney betay ko naseehat kertay huye kaha tha kay :  meray betay ! Allah kay sath shirk naa kerna . yaqeen jano shirk bara bhari zulm hai .

aur hum ney insan ko apney walaiden kay baaray mein yeh takeed ki hai ( kiyonkay ) uss ki maa ney ussay kamzori per kamzori bardasht ker kay pet mein rakha , aur do saal mein uss ka doodh chootta hai kay tum mera shukar ada kero , aur apney maa baap ka .   meray paas hi ( tumhen ) loat ker aana hai .

aur agar woh tum per yeh zor daalen kay tum meray sath kissi ko ( khudai mein ) shareek qarar do jiss ki tumharay paas koi daleel nahi to unn ki baat matt maano , aur duniya mein unn kay sath bhalai say raho ,   aur aesay shaks ka raasta apnao jiss ney mujh say lo laga rakhi ho .   phir tum sabb ko meray paas loat ker aana hai , uss waqt mein tumhen bataon ga kay tum kiya kertay rahey ho .

. ( luqman ney yeh bhi kaha : )  beta ! agar koi cheez raai kay daney kay barabar bhi ho , aur woh kissi chatan mein ho , ya aasmano mein ya zameen mein , tab bhi Allah ussay hazir kerday ga . yaqeen jano Allah bara bareek-been , boht ba-khabar hai .
beta ! namaz qaeem kero , aur logon  ko naiki ki talqeen kero , aur burai say roko , aur tumhen jo takleef paish aaye , uss per sabar kero . beyshak yeh bari himmat ka kaam hai .
aur logon  kay samney ( ghuroor say ) apney gaal matt phulao , aur zameen per itratay huye matt chalo . yaqeen jano Allah kissi itraney walay shekhi baaz ko pasand nahi kerta .
aur apni chaal mein aetidaal ikhtiyar kero ,   aur apni aawaz aahista rakho .   beyshak sabb say buri aawaz gadhon ki aawaz hai .

kiya tum logon  ney yeh nahi dekha kay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , ussay Allah ney tumharay kaam mein laga rakha hai ,   aur tum per apni zahiri aur batni naimaten poori poori nichawar ki hain-? phir bhi insanon mein say kuch log hain jo Allah kay baaray mein behasen kertay hain , jabkay unn kay paas naa koi ilm hai , naa hidayat hai , aur naa koi aesi kitab hai jo roshni dikhaye .

aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay :  uss cheez ki ittaba kero jo Allah ney utaari hai  to woh kehtay hain :  nahi , balkay hum to uss tareeqay kay peechay chalen gay jiss per hum ney apney baap dadon ko paya hai .  bhala agar shetan unn ( baap dadon ) ko bharakti aag kay azab ki taraf bulata raha ho , kiya tab bhi ( woh unhi kay peechay chalen gay-? )

aur jo shaks farmanbardaar ban ker apna rukh Allah ki taraf kerday , aur naik amal kernay wala ho , to uss ney yaqeenan bara mazboot kunda thaam liya . aur tamam kamon ka aakhri anjam Allah hi kay hawalay hai .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jiss kissi ney kufr apna liya hai , tumhen uss ka kufr sadmay mein naa daalay . aakhir unhen humaray paas hi to loattna hai , phir hum unhen batayen gay kay unhon ney kiya kiya hai ? yaqeenan Allah seenon mein chupi hoi baaton ko bhi khoob janta hai .
hum unhen kuch mazay uraney ka moaqa dey rahey hain , phir hum unhen aik sakht azab ki taraf kheench kerlay jayen gay .

aur agar tum unn say poocho kay woh kon hai jiss ney aasmano aur zameen ko peda kiya hai ? to woh zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  Allah !  kaho :  Alhamdulillah !  iss kay bawajood unn mein say aksar log samajh say kaam nahi letay .
Allah hi ka hai jo kuch aasmano aur zameen mein hai , beyshak Allah hi hai jo sabb say bey niaz hai , bazaat-e-khud qabil-e-tareef .

aur zameen mein jitney darkht hain , agar woh qalam ban jayen , aur yeh jo samandar hai , uss kay ilawa saat samandar uss kay sath aur mil jayen , ( aur woh roshnai ban ker Allah ki sifaat likhen ) tab bhi Allah ki baaten khatam nahi hon gi . haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
tum sabb ko peda kerna aur dobara zinda kerna ( Allah kay liye ) aisa hi hai jaisay aik insan ko ( peda kerna aur dobara zinda kerna ) yaqeenan Allah her baat sunta , her cheez dekhta hai .

kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay Allah raat ko din mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur din ko raat mein dakhil ker deta hai , aur uss ney sooraj aur chaand ko kaam mein laga rakha hai kay her aik kissi mutayyan miyaad tak rawan dawan hai , aur ( kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi ) kay Allah poori tarah ba-khabar hai kay tum kiya kertay ho-?

yeh sabb kuch iss liye hai kay Allah hi ka wajood sacha hai , aur iss/uss kay siwa jinn ( maboodon ) ko yeh ( mushrik ) pukartay hain , woh bey buniyad hain , aur Allah hi woh hai jiss ki shaan boht oonchi hai , jiss ki zaat boht bari .

kiya tum ney nahi dekha kay kashtiyan samandar mein Allah ki meharbani say chalti hain , takay woh tumhen apni kuch nishaniyan dikhaye-? yaqeenan iss mein her uss shaks kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain jo sabar ka paka , aalaa darjay ka shukar guzaar ho .

aur jab mojen sayebanon ki tarah unn per charh aati hain to woh Allah ko iss tarah pukartay hain kay uss waqt unn ka aetiqaad khalis ussi per hota hai . phir jab woh unn ko bacha ker khushki per ley aata hai to unn mein say kuch hain jo raah-e-raast per rehtay hain ( baqi phir shirk kernay lagtay hain ) aur humari aayaton ka inkar wohi shaks kerta hai jo paka bad-ehad , perlay darjay ka nashukra ho .

aey logo ! apney perwerdigar ( ki narazi ) say bacho , aur daro uss din say jab koi baap apney betay kay kaam nahi aaye ga , aur naa kissi betay ki yeh majal hogi kay woh apney baap kay zara bhi kaam aajaye . yaqeen jano kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , iss liye aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay yeh dunyawi zindagi tumhen dhokay mein daal dey , aur aisa hergiz naa honey paye kay woh ( shetan ) tumhen Allah kay moamlay mein dhokay mein daal dey jo sabb say bara dhoka baaz hai .

yaqeenan ( qayamat ki ) gharri ka ilm Allah hi kay paas hai , wohi barish barsata hai , aur wohi janta hai kay maon kay pet mein kiya hai , aur kissi mutanaffas ko yeh pata nahi hai kay woh kal kiya kamaye ga , aur naa kissi mutanaffas ko yeh pata hai kay konsi zameen mein ussay moat aaye gi . beyshak Allah her cheez ka mukammal ilm rakhney wala , her baat say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
